title: An MCP server for Dynamics 365 Business Central? Why not?
summary: The Model Context Protocol (MCP) is an open standard that enables AI applications to connect with external tools and data sources in a standardized way. An MCP server for Dynamics 365 Business Central allows AI agents and Copilot tools to access ERP data and perform Business Central operations through a unified, reusable protocol that works across different AI platforms.
key_points: MCP standardizes how AI models connect to external systems, replacing the need for custom integrations for each data source
MCP differs from function calling by handling execution and system integration across diverse platforms, not just generating function calls
An MCP server for Business Central exposes data and operations that any MCP-compliant tool like GitHub Copilot, Claude Desktop, or Cursor can directly access and use
MCP follows a client-server architecture where hosts connect to multiple servers that expose data sources and capabilities
MCP is particularly valuable for enterprise-scale scenarios with many tools and LLMs, reducing dependency on specific LLM formats
